test_title: PYST 03: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 04 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Identify the sentence with the INCORRECT usage of an adverb.

options.text: We are hardly ever late for work.
Chandni is late often for work.
They are usually late for work.
Mahesh and Mukesh are always late for work.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Chandni is late often for work .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Adverbs of frequency** (always, often, usually, rarely, never) are typically placed before the main verb in a sentence.
 
• In the incorrect sentence, "often" is placed after the verb "is late," which is not the typical placement for an adverb of frequency.
 
• To correct the sentence, the adverb should come before the verb: "Chandni is often late for work."

Correct sentence: *Chandni is **often** late for work.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **We are hardly ever late for work:** Correct usage. "Hardly ever" is an adverbial phrase placed correctly before the main verb.
 
• **They are usually late for work:** Correct usage. "Usually" is an adverb placed correctly before the main verb.
 
• **Mahesh and Mukesh are always late for work:** Correct usage. "Always" is an adverb placed correctly before the main verb.
